imports.name: lucide-messages-circle
imports.scope: Official messages-circle SVG paths reused without geometry changes for Flash Chat navigation and headings. Wrapped by the existing lucide-react createLucideIcon because version 1.27.0 does not yet export this icon.

imports.name: open-claude-ui
imports.scope: CDS 2.0 timing/easing, component radius hierarchy and compositor-only reveal/skeleton patterns adapted to existing WinOne settings and native menu primitives. No proprietary fonts, branding, audio, chat, cloud features or external runtime imported.

imports.name: windows-capture-recording
imports.scope: windows-capture 2.0.1 WGC runtime; MediaStreamSource event/deferral and profile setup adapted with a bounded queue, pooled IBuffer ownership, real VFR duration, pause clock and safe file publication.

imports.name: gifski-recording
imports.scope: Statically linked gifski 1.34.0 library only, default CLI/PNG/FFmpeg features disabled. Vendored from the exact release with additive buffer-recycle and final-PTS APIs; see third_party/gifski/WINONE.md. Full transitive notices in recording-notices.json. Combined distribution must comply with GPLv3/AGPLv3 section 13 and provide corresponding source; root WinOne license is not rewritten.

imports.name: magpie-curl-import
imports.scope: Pure curlOf/respellURL functions and ten provider examples reused for paste import. Commands are parsed as text, never executed. WinOne keeps its own form, drafts and credential store.

imports.name: croc-interconnect
imports.scope: Direct reuse of croc v11.5.5 transfer, store client, encryption and original tests. WinOne adapts progress, input prompts and process lifecycle only.

imports.name: chitchatter-interconnect
imports.scope: Complete headless chat core and original tests from production main. Only import paths are adapted; WinOne supplies presentation and platform adapters.

imports.name: fileshare-interconnect
imports.scope: Direct reuse of Rust HTTP engine, upstream tests and browser assets. WinOne adapts management, explicit paths, authentication and awaited shutdown; no transfer engine rewrite.

imports.name: tailcat-interconnect
imports.scope: Official v0.7.0 library dependency; forward listener lifecycle adapted from cmd/tailcat/forward.go. WinOne adds process control and a standard HTTP gateway to the existing FileShare service.
